title: Kid Thomas's showmanship and walking out of halls
summary: Anecdotes of Thomas singing in costume, walking outside while playing, and blowing at windows to draw a crowd.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Yeah, those, those, I hear him sing the Milk Cow Blues and the A-Lap Bar. Did he used to sing a lot of different stuff? He doesn't seem to sing too much.

No, he never just sing too much but yeah, Black Thomas used to make you fall out, always dressing up in different things. A little nightgown and a little hangout. Different things, yeah. All kinds of funny hats and oh, he come out with a dress on and all. People used to fall out, you know. He used to be a cowl girl, right? Yeah, he used to be cowl.
Yeah, he used to walk around with balance in a tray on his head once.

Yeah, that's right, that's right. Oh yeah, Thomas. And he used to get out off the bandstand and no care how big a hall was, his band would still be playing. And all I'd want to do just be so I could hear that trumpet, so I could keep the time. He used to get out off the bandstand and walk all around and sometimes you didn't know where he was going. He'd be all around outside and come through the back, but just so I could hear that trumpet. He's still playing his trumpet? Still playing his trumpet. Walked outside the hall.
He did it over to Tip Top about a year ago or so, yeah.

I don't remember going outside the hall. They went to New York Berry to play a dance once. And people was a little late coming in. And they was on the outside. Oh they had plenty of people on the outside. So Thomas said, I'm going to get them in here. Thomas started to blow, we was playing, Thomas started blowing his horn trumpet and went on the outside and went to the window each window and people started to run in there though. They really packed that hole that night. Thomas said, I was going to get them in here. See, all I had to do was just go to that window and play.
That's right. It's all just kicks.
